items.label: VERSATILE DESIGN
items.value: This 12-inch tablet is a 2-in-1 laptop that suits you. Experience the power of a laptop and the flexibility of a tablet. Use it as a tablet, prop it up with a leather case stand, or attach the magnetic keyboard (included) to turn it into a full thin and light Windows laptop

items.label: 12-INCH 2K IPS TOUCHSCREEN DISPLAY
items.value: Enjoy bright visuals and rich sound on the 12-inch 2K (2000 x 1200) IPS touchscreen, ultra-narrow bezel, screen-to-body ratio as high as 90%, 16:9 aspect ratio is ideal for presentations, streaming, learning, decompressing, etc. Dual stereo speakers makes your media crystal clear, enjoy rich sound

items.label: POWERFUL INTEL N95 PROCESSOR
items.value: Equipped with the latest Intel Alder Lake N95 processor (4C/4T, 6M Cache, up to 3.4GHz) for smooth multitasking, fast performance, and reliable productivity across home, office, school, work, and entertainment

items.label: SPACIOUS 12GB DDR5 RAM & 512 GB SSD STORAGE
items.value: This tablet has 12 GB DDR5 RAM, delivering up to 40% higher bandwidth and 50% faster data transfer speeds compared to DDR4-3200, easily switch back and forth between open applications. 512 GB SSD to store all your documents, apps, videos, and photos with fast load times and generous space

items.label: SLIM & LIGHT
items.value: Carry your tablet easily with a slim, light design that's also durable, only 0.4 inch in thickness, 2-in-1 laptop is the perfect blend of performance and portability to help you bring the fun with you wherever you go

items.label: ADVANCED DUAL USB-C HUB
items.value: All-day productivity with a fast-charging port and a fully-functional port for 4K video, data transfer & versatile connectivity, plus dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Micro SD, DC-in, and a 3.5mm audio jack

items.label: OPERATING SYSTEM
items.value: Pre-installed with Windows 11 Home system is ideal for school education, casual gaming, online classes, designers, professionals, small businesses, programmers, streaming, remote learning, Zoom meetings, video conferences
